hold_text: Tier-2 by path: src/runtime/order_monitor.py is the live order monitor's close path, including for the real-money alpaca_live account. Dispatched by the manager (session_01HYq6XtfesZ57VyaQrK6CL1, decision 2026-09-30 20:37Z) to lane ALPACA-CLOSE-WEDGE as a HELD PR, independently reviewed and merged by the manager. What changes on the order path: a close result is now classified as a market-session DEFER (via the new _is_session_defer) also when it carries AlpacaClient's extended-hours trade-scoped phrase 'deferred to the regular session'. Detection is by phrase only, never retCode 2 (the regular-hours 'position size unreadable … DEFERRED rather than' retCode 2 stays a paging failure). An Alpaca defer ('us_equity market closed' / 'extended-hours') seen while the US equity clock reads RTH is NOT honoured: it counts toward the streak and pages, so no deferral wording stays silent past the open (review round 1). A defer clears the close-failure streak and never pages, and because that message says 'protective bracket left armed; nothing placed', it releases the active-close marker so the naked sweep keeps checking the position. Nothing new is placed or cancelled, and real failures are unchanged (tests pin that). Also carries three Tier-1 pipeline records: ZIFJ1RKM-0003 live evidence (folded in from #14895) and ZIFJ1RKM-0004 closed with a tripwire. Revert: git revert of the merge commit.
